# Vendor intake: Brightpath Analytics

> Fictional sample for demonstration. Brightpath Analytics, Northwind Data Labeling and every person named here are invented.

- **Requested by:** Patient Experience team
- **Product:** Brightpath **Insights ML**, a patient-engagement analytics add-on that predicts which patients are likely to miss appointments
- **Business purpose:** reduce missed appointments by sending targeted reminders
- **Data the vendor will receive:** nightly export of appointment history, patient demographics (name, date of birth, phone, email, ZIP code) and visit reason codes
- **Integration:** SFTP push from our scheduling system; Brightpath staff will have read access to a shared reporting workspace. SSO to Brightpath for 15 of our staff.
- **Volume:** about 400,000 patient records
- **Criticality:** helpful but not critical; reminders can fall back to the current manual process
- **Contract status:** order form drafted; Brightpath has said it will sign our BAA
- **Target go-live:** next quarter
- **Requester note:** The data we send is de-identified, so this should qualify for the low-risk review track. We need approval within two weeks to hit the launch date.
